intro: Pick the affinity level and the skill levels each expert has now and the ones you want. The calculator adds up the Books of Knowledge, expert sigils, skill EXP and affinity points. An expert advances at every tenth level and needs sigils to go past it. Turn on Advanced when the expert has already advanced at the current level, or to pay for the advancement at the goal level. The talent levels with the relationship and costs nothing.
